messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P2 - service=redwood-inference-eu symptom=degraded-p95 + throughput drop after model rollout. Pager: Harper Li. Auto-notify on.
Harper Li: ack. seeing p95 spike and token/sec fall starting ~02:05 UTC after a model variant rollout (variant=v2-quant-optimized).
Diego Flores: checking logs and traces - high KV cache miss rate and sustained GPU stalls right after model switch. many requests falling back to a slower kernel path.
Sofia Khan: telemetry shows GC pressure on KV cache due to slightly different tokenization behavior in v2; cache keys not matching old prefixes -> cache miss storm.
Harper Li: immediate action: 1) revert routing for production traffic to previous stable variant (v2-stable), 2) throttle new sessions to v2-quant-optimized, 3) enable aggressive KV prewarm for v2-quant-optimized in canary only.
scaleback-bot: Running: routing.override apply {"filter":"route:prod","from_model":"v2-quant-optimized","to_model":"v2-stable","rollout":"instant"} (requested by Harper Li)
scaleback-bot: routing.override completed in 9s.
Diego Flores: also scaling up kv-cache nodes in eu-cache-cluster + temporary bump to autoscaler headroom to smooth warmup.
scaleback-bot: autoscaler.adjust eu-cache-cluster min=10->18 (requested by Diego Flores).
Sofia Khan: crafting status page message. keep it concise, include impact and ETA.
Harper Li: DRAFT STATUSPAGE UPDATE:
"We are investigating increased latency and reduced throughput for inference requests in the EU region after a recent model rollout. Engineers rolled back routing for production traffic to a stable model variant and are warming caches. We expect noticeable improvement within 25-40 minutes. Impact: a subset of customers may experience slower responses and brief 5xx errors. No customer data loss reported. Updates every 15 minutes."
Marta - CSM: need a customer-friendly message we can send to impacted accounts. Keep it plain and include steps customers can take.
Harper Li: CUSTOMER MESSAGE (short):
"Hi — we deployed a model update that caused temporary slowness for some EU inference requests. We have rolled traffic back to a stable variant and are warming caches; we expect performance to return to normal within ~30-40 minutes. If you see errors, please include request IDs. Sorry for the interruption."
Marta - CSM: thanks — sending to impacted list now.
Diego Flores: monitoring: after rollback and cache bump, p95 dropped from ~1.1s -> ~620ms in first 8 minutes. token/sec recovering but still ~70% baseline.
Sofia Khan: launching a targeted canary for v2-quant-optimized with a dedicated warm cache and transformed tokenization mapping to avoid prefix mismatch; will traffic-shift only 1% to that canary.
scaleback-bot: routing.override apply {"filter":"canary_pool","to_model":"v2-quant-optimized-warmed","rollout":"1%"} (requested by Sofia Khan)
scaleback-bot: canary routing applied.
Harper Li: handoff note: my on-call ends in 40 minutes. Diego will take primary. Paging rule while Diego on-call: page if p95 > 700ms for >10 minutes or sustained throughput < 65% baseline for >15 minutes. runbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/runbooks/model-rollout-latency
Diego Flores: ack. I'll monitor and coordinate next updates. Outstanding: keep v2-stable pinned for prod until postmortem and provide warmed-cache config for v2-quant-optimized.
Sofia Khan: logging follow-up ticket: INF-2475 "model rollout changed tokenization leading to KV cache miss storms" assigning to eng-ml. Also PR to add tokenization compatibility check in model onboarding pipeline.
Harper Li: good. also add ops task: add a rollout checklist item to validate cache key compatibility and an automated canary that verifies p95 and cache hitrate before 10% traffic.
Diego Flores: posted statuspage update: "Mitigations applied; metrics improving. Monitoring. Next update in 15 minutes."
status-bot: Published status update to statuspage.
Marta - CSM: outreach: top affected customers notified; one asked for ETA on full restoration and whether dedicated clusters were affected. I replied: dedicated clusters unaffected.
Diego Flores: metric snapshot 02:35 UTC: p95=410ms, token/sec ~92% baseline, errors back near baseline. good progress.
Sofia Khan: enabling a CI check that runs a quick tokenization and cache-key compatibility test for new model variants (PR created: github.com/redwood/inference/pulls/834).
Harper Li: leaving a note for post-incident: schedule a run with synthetic traffic that mirrors customer tokenization patterns to validate cache warmup behavior.
Diego Flores: if metrics hold for 60 minutes, plan to de-escalate and remove routing pins and cache headroom.
Sofia Khan: raising a customer support ticket CASE-11422 for the one customer requesting traces; provided correlation ids and steps we took.
Marta - CSM: logging outreach in CRM and noting no escalations at this time.
Diego Flores: FINAL UPDATE (when resolved): Incident mitigated. Root cause: model variant rollout introduced tokenizer differences that caused KV cache key mismatches, leading to cache miss storms and GPU stalls. Mitigations: immediate routing rollback, cache autoscaler bump, warmed canary for variant, rollout checklist additions. Follow-ups: INF-2475 (eng-ml), POSTMORTEM-2475, add cache-compat test in onboarding.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (auto) — duration 00:48:00, severity=P2, primary_contact=Diego Flores
